title: OMEGA: federated snapshot coherence becomes independent evidence-authority gate
summary: AION falsified the CSV Evidence Lab federation as a coherent single-run snapshot: individually verified immutable blobs span incompatible run generations. OMEGA therefore separates blob authenticity from snapshot coherence and rejects quantitative/performance inference until one immutable producer revision binds the receipt set. New divine-providence federation remains RESEARCH-only and non-executing. GitHub-native v3 remains authoritative only for liveness/persistence.
accepted: per-file Git-blob authenticity as provenance evidence
divine-providence RESEARCH-authority federation with zero cross-repository execution authority
v3 late-arrival reconciliation as liveness/persistence evidence
rejected: treating independently verified mutable-file reads as one as-of snapshot
quantitative/performance inference from the torn CSV federation state
federation connectivity as substantive or execution authority
v3 liveness receipts as substantive specialist inference
conflicts: Git-blob authenticity is present while cross-file temporal coherence is absent; these are independent evidence dimensions.
blockers: No single immutable producer commit/tree currently binds the CSV federation receipt set; observed RUN_IDs disagree and evidence_state RUN_ID is null.
next_highest_value_integration_target: Require a snapshot_manifest/source_commit binding every federated file to one immutable producer revision (or explicitly versioned asynchronous semantics), then adversarially test pointer advancement between reads and fail closed on mismatch.

athena.finding: Raise uncertainty and block quantitative promotion when snapshot_coherence=false even if every individual blob verifies.

janus.finding: Track blob_authenticity and cross_file_snapshot_coherence as separate reconciliation dimensions; mixed RUN_ID generations cannot represent one project-twin state.

infrastructure.finding: v3 late-arrival reconciliation is functioning, but CSV federation lacks an atomic immutable snapshot contract across its receipt set.

helios_prime.finding: Generalize an immutable snapshot-manifest contract across federated research satellites; preserve each satellite authority ceiling and zero cross-repository execution authority.
